territorial_scope.description: Addresses deep synthesis services under national governance, with local internet information and telecommunications and public security departments acting within their administrative regions.

evidence.quote: The state internet information department is responsible for the overall planning and coordination of the nation's governance of deep synthesis services

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Governs providers, technical supporters and users of internet services that apply deep synthesis technology to generate or edit text, voice, images, video or virtual scenes. Imposes content review, real-name verification, labelling and filing duties; effective 10 January 2023.
summary.long: Governs providers, technical supporters and users of internet services that apply deep synthesis technology to generate or edit text, voice, images, video or virtual scenes (Arts. 2, 23). The state internet information department coordinates oversight, with telecommunications and public security departments and local counterparts acting within their duties (Art. 3). Users may not produce prohibited or fake news content (Art. 6). Providers must run management systems, verify users' real identity, review inputs and outputs, handle complaints and dispel rumours (Arts. 7–12). App stores must check security assessments and filings (Art. 13). Providers must manage training data, obtain individual consent for biometric editing functions, review algorithms, and security-assess biometric or sensitive-content tools (Arts. 14–15). Synthetic content must carry technical symbols and, for listed services, conspicuous labels; deleting labels is prohibited (Arts. 16–18). Services with public-opinion or mobilisation capacity must file and assess new products (Arts. 19–20). Authorities may inspect and request suspension of services; violations are punished under other laws, with criminal liability where a crime is constituted (Arts. 21–22). Effective 10 January 2023 (Art. 25).

Art. 2 defers to other laws and administrative regulations where they provide otherwise. No penalty amounts are stated; Art. 22 refers to other laws and administrative regulations and to criminal responsibility without figures. events.date_text: These rules shall take effect on January 10, 2023.

evidence.quote: These rules shall take effect on January 10, 2023.
These Provisions apply to the application of deep synthesis technology to provide internet information services (hereinafter simply Deep Synthesis Services).

Deep synthesis technology refers to the use of technologies such as deep learning and virtual reality, that use generative sequencing algorithms to create text, images, audio, video, virtual scenes, or other information
"deep synthesis service providers“ refers to organizations and individuals providing deep synthesis services.

definitions.term: deep synthesis service providers' technical supporters

evidence.quote: "Deep synthesis service providers' technical supporters“ refers to organizations and individuals that provide technical support for deep synthesis services.
"Deep synthesis service users" refers to organizations and individuals using deep synthesis services to make, reproduce, publish, or transmit information.
"Training data" refers to annotated or benchmark datasets that are used to train machine learning models.
"Immersive scenes" refers to highly realistic virtual scenes that are generated or edited by applying deep synthesis technology and can be experienced or interacted with by participants.

obligations.summary: The state internet information department is responsible for overall planning and coordination of governance of deep synthesis services; telecommunications and public security departments oversee within their duties; local departments perform the same roles in their regions.

evidence.quote: The state internet information department is responsible for the overall planning and coordination of the nation's governance of deep synthesis services

obligations.summary: Provision of deep synthesis services must comply with laws and regulations, respect social mores and ethics, and adhere to the correct political direction and values.

evidence.quote: The provision of deep synthesis services shall comply with laws and regulations, respect social mores and ethics

obligations.summary: Deep synthesis services must not be used to produce or transmit prohibited information or engage in prohibited activities; providers and users must not use the services to produce or transmit fake news information.

evidence.quote: Deep synthesis services must not be used by any organization or individual to produce, reproduce, publish, or transmit information that is prohibited by laws or administrative regulations

obligations.summary: Providers must establish and complete management systems for user registration, algorithm mechanism review, scientific ethics review, information publication review, data security, personal information protection, prevention of telecommunication network fraud, and emergency response.

evidence.quote: shall implement primary responsibility for information security, establishing and completing management systems

obligations.summary: Providers must have safe and controllable technical safeguard measures.

evidence.quote: shall have safe and controllable technical safeguard measures

obligations.summary: Providers must draft and disclose management rules and platform covenants, improve service agreements, and post in a conspicuous manner the security obligations of technical supporters and users.

evidence.quote: shall draft and disclose management rules and platform covenants

obligations.summary: Providers must verify the real identity of users (via phone numbers, ID card numbers, unified social credit codes or the state online identity verification service) and must not provide information publication services to unverified users.

evidence.quote: shall verify the real identity information of the users of the deep synthesis services in accordance with law

obligations.summary: Providers must strengthen management of deep synthesis content, review user inputs and synthesis outcomes by technical or manual means, maintain a pool of characteristics for identifying illegal and negative content, and take measures against violating users (warnings, restricted functions, suspensions, account closures).

evidence.quote: employ technical measures or manual methods to conduct reviews of the data inputted by users and synthesis outcomes

obligations.summary: Providers must record and store related network logs, and store related records when addressing illegal or negative information.

evidence.quote: record and store related network logs

obligations.summary: Upon discovering illegal or negative information, providers must address it in accordance with law and promptly report to the telecommunications department or relevant departments in charge.
obligations.conditional_on: Where the provider discovers illegal or negative information

evidence.quote: make a report to the telecommunications department or relevant departments in charge

obligations.summary: Providers must establish and complete mechanisms for dispelling rumors and promptly employ measures to dispel false information produced or transmitted with their services.

evidence.quote: shall establish and complete mechanisms for dispelling rumors

obligations.summary: Upon discovering false information produced or transmitted using the services, providers must store related records and report to the internet information departments and relevant departments in charge.
obligations.conditional_on: Where it is discovered that the services were used to produce or transmit false information

evidence.quote: make a report to the internet information departments and relevant departments in charge

obligations.summary: Providers must set up convenient portals for user appeals, public complaints and reports, publish the handling process and response time limits, and give feedback on outcomes.

evidence.quote: shall set up convenient portals for user appeals, public complaints, and reports

obligations.summary: Application stores and distribution platforms must implement safety management responsibilities (pre-offering review, routine management, emergency response) and check deep synthesis services' security assessments and filings.

evidence.quote: check deep synthesis services' security assessments, filings, and other such situations

obligations.summary: Where relevant state provisions are violated, application distribution platforms must promptly act, such as not making the service available, issuing warnings, suspending services, or removing it.
obligations.conditional_on: Where relevant state provisions are violated

evidence.quote: they shall promptly employ measures to address it such as not making it available on the market, warnings, suspending services, or taking it off the market

obligations.summary: Providers and technical supporters must strengthen management of training data and employ necessary measures to ensure its security; where training data includes personal information, the personal information protection provisions apply.

evidence.quote: shall strengthen the management of training data, employ necessary measures to ensure the security of training data

obligations.summary: Where providers offer functions for editing biometric information such as faces and voices, they must prompt users to notify the individuals whose information is edited and obtain their independent consent.
obligations.conditional_on: Where providers provide functions for editing biometric information such as faces and voices

evidence.quote: shall prompt the users of the deep synthesis service to notify the individuals whose personal information is being edited and obtain their independent consent

obligations.summary: Providers and technical supporters must strengthen technical management by periodically reviewing, assessing and verifying the algorithmic mechanisms that produce synthesis.

evidence.quote: periodically reviewing, assessing, and verifying algorithmic mechanisms that produce synthesis

obligations.summary: For tools with functions generating or editing biometric information, or non-biometric information that might involve national security, national image, national interests or the societal public interest, providers must carry out security assessments themselves or entrust a professional body.
obligations.conditional_on: Where tools have the functional models or frameworks listed in Art. 15 (1) or (2)

evidence.quote: they shall carry out security assessments either on their own or by entrusting a professional body

obligations.summary: Providers must employ technical measures to attach symbols to information content produced or edited by users, without affecting users' usage.

evidence.quote: shall employ technical measures to attach symbols to information content produced or edited by their services' users

obligations.summary: Providers must store log information in accordance with laws, administrative regulations and relevant state provisions.

evidence.quote: store log information in accordance with laws, administrative regulations, and relevant state provisions

obligations.summary: For listed services that might cause confusion or mislead the public (e.g., smart dialogue or writing, voice synthesis, virtual person generation, immersive scenes), providers must make a conspicuous label on generated or edited content; for other deep synthesis services they must provide functions for prominent labelling and alert users that they may apply such labels.
obligations.conditional_on: Where services might cause confusion or mislead the public (listed services in Art. 17 paragraph 1)

evidence.quote: they shall make a conspicuous label in a reasonable position or location on information content they generate or edit

obligations.summary: No organization or individual may employ technical measures to delete, alter or conceal the deep synthesis labels required under Articles 16 and 17.

evidence.quote: Technical measures must not be employed by any organization or individual to delete, alter, or conceal the deep synthesis labels

obligations.summary: Providers with public opinion properties or social mobilization capacity, and technical supporters on the same basis, must complete filing formalities and filing modifications or cancellations.
obligations.conditional_on: Where providers have public opinion properties or the capacity for social mobilization

evidence.quote: shall perform formalities for filing and the modification or cancellation of filings

obligations.summary: Providers and technical supporters that have completed filings must indicate their filing number and provide links to publicly displayed filing information on their websites and applications.

evidence.quote: shall indicate their filing number and provide links to publicly displayed information

obligations.summary: Providers putting new products, usages or functions online that have public opinion properties or social mobilization capacity must follow state provisions to carry out security assessments.
obligations.conditional_on: Where new products, usages or functions have public opinion properties or capacity for social mobilization

evidence.quote: shall follow the relevant state provisions to carry out security assessments

obligations.summary: Internet information departments and departments for telecommunications and public security must carry out oversight inspections of deep synthesis services within their duties.

evidence.quote: Internet information departments and departments for telecommunications and public security are to carry out oversight inspections of deep synthesis services

obligations.summary: Providers and technical supporters must lawfully cooperate with inspections and provide technological, data and other support, and when requested to suspend updates, registration or related services, must take measures to rectify and eliminate threats.

evidence.quote: shall lawfully cooperate and provide necessary technological, data, and other support and assistance

obligations.summary: Providers engaged in online publication services, online cultural activities or online audio-visual programming activities must concurrently comply with the provisions of the news publication, culture and tourism, and radio and television departments.
obligations.conditional_on: Where engaging in online publication services, online cultural activities, or online A/V programming activities

evidence.quote: shall concurrently comply with the provisions of departments for news publication, culture and tourism, and radio and television
